podcast.title: Plastic Beach Collaboration
podcast.body: Little Dragon was among the guest artists who contributed to the Gorillaz album "Plastic Beach." "The guest list for this album is pretty insane. Mick Jones and Paul Semenin, both of the clash, Dela Sol, again, Lou Reed, Moss Def, Snoop Dogg, Marquis Smith of the Fall, Little Dragon, the Lebanese National Orchestra for Arabic music..."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
